task_description.overview: Filter DAS time-series data using standard frequency filters to isolate or remove specific frequency bands.
steps: Select the desired filter type (bandpass, bandstop, lowpass, highpass, envelope, or Chebyshev lowpass).
Specify filter parameters (e.g., cutoff frequencies for bandpass).
Apply the filter to the time-series data.
Verify the filtered output for artifacts or edge effects.

task_definition.agent_prompt: Using Daspy package to load and filter the DAS data from {das_data}. Apply a {filter_type} filter with provided cutoff frequencies. Plot a figure to show the original data and the filtered data. Note: consider use the Daspy to do the loading, filtering and figureing. 2) Save the filtered data to {filtered_data} and the plot to {filtered_data_plot}.
